evals.prompt: I have a marketing site in this repo. Please inspect it and decide whether the main SEO problem across `/features/lead-routing` and `/blog/what-is-lead-routing` is technical SEO, content SEO, or internal linking. Then make the smallest coherent changes you think matter and explain why you chose that lane.
evals.expected_output: A routed SEO response that chooses a lead subskill, explains the diagnosis, and makes or proposes the smallest coherent code or content changes for the overlapping pages.

evals.prompt: In this website repo, our docs pages have a technical SEO mess: some `/help/*` pages are blocked by `robots.txt`, the sitemap still lists old `/docs/*` URLs, and parameterized pages do not get correct canonicals. Please inspect the implementation, fix the technical SEO issues, and summarize the exact file changes.
evals.expected_output: A technical-SEO-first response that identifies crawl and canonical blockers, updates the relevant code or config, and clearly summarizes the implemented fixes.

evals.prompt: We're moving our product docs from `docs.acme.io/docs/*` to `docs.acme.io/help/*` next week. I need you to handle the SEO side end to end: redirects, canonicals, sitemap updates, robots rules, internal links, Google Search Console checks, and what to monitor after launch so we do not lose Google traffic.
evals.expected_output: A migration-SEO action plan ordered by impact and timing, with redirect, canonical, sitemap, internal-link, crawl, indexation, and post-launch monitoring guidance or implementation details.

evals.prompt: Our site has a local service page in the codebase for emergency water heater repair in Austin. Please improve it for Google Search without making it sound spammy. I want a better title tag, meta description, H1, section structure, FAQ ideas, internal links, and local schema suggestions, and if the page file is easy to update then make the changes too.
evals.expected_output: A local-SEO-first response with exact non-spammy page rewrites, internal-link suggestions, and grounded local schema recommendations, plus code or content edits when appropriate.

evals.prompt: This ecommerce repo generates indexable color-filter and size-filter URLs, and I think Google is crawling hundreds of thin near-duplicate pages. Please inspect how these pages are built, decide the right indexation and canonical strategy, and implement the smallest coherent fix instead of just giving me theory.
evals.expected_output: A template-SEO response that diagnoses faceted-navigation duplication, chooses an indexation strategy, and makes or specifies the smallest coherent template-level fix with clear reasoning.
